parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, temperature: $json.temperature, messages: $json.messages, response_format: { type: 'json_object' } }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: ($json.ok === true), output: ($json.output || null), model: ($json.model || ''), usage: ($json.usage || { promptTokens: 0, completionTokens: 0, totalTokens: 0 }), errorCode: ($json.errorCode || '') } }}
